description: This Java class implements the DepositAccountInterestRateChartReadPlatformService interface. It provides methods to retrieve interest rate chart data, including single charts, charts with slabs, templates, and charts by account ID for deposit accounts. It uses JDBC for database access, mapping result sets to domain data objects, and includes nested classes for extracting and mapping database rows.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation that extracts interest rate chart data with slabs and incentives from a ResultSet.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps a ResultSet row to a DepositAccountInterestRateChartData object.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor that extracts interest rate chart slabs with incentives from a ResultSet.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps a ResultSet row to a DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData object.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveMapper
classes.description: RowMapper that maps a ResultSet row to DepositAccountInterestIncentiveData.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single interest rate chart data by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves detailed interest rate chart data along with associated slabs by chart ID.

methods.name: retrieveWithTemplate
methods.description: Enhances a chart data object with template data for dropdowns and options.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabsOnAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate chart data with slabs based on a savings account ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides an empty template for creating a new interest rate chart with dropdown options.
